items.title: Can AI win against humans in competitive multiplayer computer games?
items.x_text:
❓ Can AI win against humans in competitive multiplayer computer games?

✅ Yes, AI has defeated humans in competitive multiplayer games.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pkGa8ICQJS8
#COSMOS #Curiosity

discovery.short_answer: Yes, AI has defeated humans in competitive multiplayer games.
discovery.full_answer: AI systems have achieved victories against human players in competitive multiplayer games. In 2019, OpenAI Five defeated the world champion team OGesports in a best-of-three Dota 2 match with a 2-0 score, although the match had some rule modifications such as hero and item restrictions. Additionally, DeepMind's AlphaStar has demonstrated superior skill to 99.8% of human players in StarCraft II and won ten consecutive matches against top professionals in prerecorded sessions. However, AlphaStar lost a live-streamed final match to a professional player, showing that while AI can outperform many humans, outcomes can vary in live competitive settings.
discovery.grok_perspective: Successes in particular games do not necessarily extend to all competitive multiplayer formats, where human teams may adapt strategies in ways that challenge AI systems.

items.title: When is an offensive lineman allowed to move?
items.x_text:
❓ When is an offensive lineman allowed to move?

✅ An offensive lineman can move smoothly before the snap without simulating it.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rodt4X8ltOc
#COSMOS #nfl

discovery.short_answer: An offensive lineman can move smoothly before the snap without simulating it.
discovery.full_answer: According to college football rules, offensive linemen are allowed to move before the snap as part of a smooth, rhythmical shift or motion. However, all offensive players must come to a complete stop for at least one full second before the ball is snapped. The key restriction is that no player should make quick, jerky movements that could simulate the start of the play. Movements like shifting feet, shoulders, arms, or head in a sudden way are not allowed. The purpose of these rules is to prevent players from mimicking the snap to confuse the defense. Officials judge whether the movement is a legal shift or an attempt to simulate the snap. This principle is consistent in college football and likely similar in the NFL.
discovery.grok_perspective: Rules on offensive lineman movement are specified in league rulebooks and can depend on context or official interpretation. Exact allowances require direct reference to those documents.

items.title: What is the difference between added sugars and natural sugars in processed foods?
items.x_text:
❓ What is the difference between added sugars and natural sugars in processed foods?

✅ Added sugars are extra sugars added to foods; natural sugars occur naturally.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TrvNvujKKW8
#COSMOS #sugar

discovery.short_answer: Added sugars are extra sugars added to foods; natural sugars occur naturally.
discovery.full_answer: Added sugars refer to sugars that are introduced into foods during processing or preparation, whereas natural sugars are those inherently present in whole foods like fruits. The key difference lies in how these sugars affect the body. Natural sugars in fruits come with fiber and other components that slow sugar absorption, resulting in a lower glycemic index and a slower rise in blood sugar. In contrast, added sugars increase the glycemic index because they lack these slowing factors, leading to quicker blood sugar spikes. However, when fruit sugars are extracted into juices, the fiber is removed, causing the sugars to be absorbed rapidly, similar to added sugars. Labeling added sugars helps consumers identify extra sugars added to foods but does not indicate how quickly the sugars, natural or added, will affect blood sugar levels. Some manufacturers may add sugary juices instead of pure sugar, which may not be labeled as added sugar despite increasing sugar content.
discovery.grok_perspective: The distinction between added and natural sugars in processed foods may vary based on specific manufacturing processes and labeling standards. Review of individual product details is advisable for precise understanding.

items.title: Is there any advantage to cooking steak on the bone?
items.x_text:
❓ Is there any advantage to cooking steak on the bone?

✅ Yes, bone slows cooking and helps retain moisture in steak.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7yXK0Xokg7E
#COSMOS #meat

discovery.short_answer: Yes, bone slows cooking and helps retain moisture in steak.
discovery.full_answer: Cooking steak on the bone does not enhance flavor through marrow infusion, as the bone is too dense for marrow to affect the meat's taste. However, the bone acts as insulation, slowing the cooking process and reducing moisture loss, which can improve texture. Additionally, the bone helps maintain the steak's shape during cooking. A practical tip is to remove the bone and tie it back to the meat before cooking, which preserves these benefits while making carving easier after cooking. Overall, the main advantage of cooking steak on the bone is better heat retention and moisture preservation, rather than flavor enhancement from the bone itself.
discovery.grok_perspective: Opinions differ on whether bone-in steaks provide noticeable benefits, as outcomes often depend on cut thickness, cooking technique, and personal preference. Any perceived differences remain subtle and context-specific.

items.title: Early payoff of mortgages: does the interest get recalculated?
items.x_text:
❓ Early payoff of mortgages: does the interest get recalculated?

✅ Interest is not recalculated on past payments after early payoff.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YbjGvgp19pM
#COSMOS #mortgage

discovery.short_answer: Interest is not recalculated on past payments after early payoff.
discovery.full_answer: When you pay off a mortgage early, the interest rate remains the same and is calculated only on the remaining principal at each point in time. The interest you paid on previous monthly payments is based on the principal balance at those times and is not recalculated retroactively. Making additional payments reduces the principal faster, so future interest amounts decrease accordingly. If you pay off the loan completely, you stop paying interest because there is no remaining principal. Therefore, no interest is lost or recalculated for past payments; the benefit of early payoff is paying less interest going forward due to the lower principal balance.
discovery.grok_perspective: Mortgage terms and local rules can affect how interest is handled in early payoffs, so outcomes may vary by contract. Direct review of the specific agreement is advisable.

items.title: What are some electronic payment systems available for use by foreigners in India?
items.x_text:
❓ What are some electronic payment systems available for use by foreigners in India?

✅ Visa, MasterCard, and Maestro cards are widely accepted in India.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rJq9QOo8Ak0
#COSMOS #india

discovery.short_answer: Visa, MasterCard, and Maestro cards are widely accepted in India.
discovery.full_answer: Foreigners in India can use Visa, MasterCard, and Maestro cards for electronic payments, especially in supermarkets and major cities. These cards are accepted at many ATMs, particularly around train stations, allowing cash withdrawals without currency conversion fees if declined. However, many other types of electronic payments, including popular Western mobile payment systems like Samsung Pay and Google Pay, are generally not available or widely accepted. For most purchases beyond groceries, cash remains the primary payment method. This information is based on experiences from early 2019 across various Indian states including Goa, Mumbai, and New Delhi.
discovery.grok_perspective: Acceptance of electronic payments for foreigners in India can vary by region and establishment, so confirming compatibility with local systems is advisable prior to travel.

items.title: How to compute worth of my equity?
items.x_text:
❓ How to compute worth of my equity?

✅ Calculate equity worth by company value and your share percentage.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j0dN9QUA9wo
#COSMOS #equity

discovery.short_answer: Calculate equity worth by company value and your share percentage.
discovery.full_answer: To compute the worth of your equity, you need to know two key things: the total number of shares outstanding and the overall value of the company. Your equity's value is roughly your ownership percentage multiplied by the company's value. For example, if you have options to buy 100,000 shares but the company has 1 billion shares outstanding, you own 0.01% of the company. The actual value depends on the company's market value or estimated future cash flows. Since private company shares aren't publicly traded, their worth is what someone is willing to pay. Additionally, vesting schedules affect how many shares you actually own over time. Without a public market or a company sale, estimating exact value is difficult and involves risk.
discovery.grok_perspective: Equity valuation often depends on factors like liquidity and specific terms that may not be immediately clear from basic figures alone. Professional input is typically advisable for accuracy.
